verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented feature for viewing Honeycomb spend or usage, attributing ingest volume to teams or services, or alerting on usage spikes before billing. The pricing page states only plan event-volume limits. Generic Triggers and Query Builder could approximate this only as a user-built workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
